scripts.build: nuxt generate && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')){ fs.mkdirSync('.output/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', '.output/public', {recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync('dist/_redirects', '/* /index.html 200\n'); fs.writeFileSync('.output/public/_redirects', '/* /index.html 200\n'); }"
scripts.generate: nuxt generate && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')){ fs.mkdirSync('.output/public', {recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', '.output/public', {recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync('dist/_redirects', '/* /index.html 200\n'); fs.writeFileSync('.output/public/_redirects', '/* /index.html 200\n'); }"
